log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Bring Garchomp/Gholdengo/Mimikyu for broad coverage. Mega Garchomp EQ/Stone Edge threatens Sneasler, Kingambit, Garganacl, Gholdengo. Gholdengo handles Primarina and recovers. Mimikyu Disguise checks Dragonite/Sneasler, cleans with priority. Lead Garchomp, pivot vs Dragonite/Primarina.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating team matchup and speed tiers to select three Pokémon and identify key threats.Refining the trio to balance pivot, revenge, and coverage against physical threats and setup sweepers.

decisions.thought: Lead Primarina to handle Garchomp, Dragonite, Kingambit, and Rotom-Wash. Bring Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale + Ice Spinner/EQ/ESpeed) as setup sweeper and pivot. Bring Gholdengo (Choice Scarf) to revenge kill Mimikyu, opposing Gholdengo, and faster threats. Preserve Dragonite's Multiscale until ready to sweep.

Opponent lead Primarina; unknown 2 others. Garchomp threatened by Moonblast/Ice, pivot Gholdengo which resists both. Save Mega Garchomp for Kingambit/Garganacl/Sneasler/Gholdengo. Gholdengo can pressure Primarina and Recover. Mimikyu Disguise saved to check Dragonite/Sneasler and clean with priority.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon 3v3 matchup and damage calculations to evaluate Garchomp lead versus Primarina and Gholdengo switch options.

decisions.thought: Opponent led Garchomp. Primarina survives any single hit from Garchomp with Sitrus Berry and threatens an OHKO with Moonblast (or drops it to Focus Sash range for Aqua Jet). If they switch out to Gholdengo/Kingambit/Rotom-W, we get solid chip and information. Preserve Dragonite's Multiscale and Scarf Gholdengo for later.

Opponent lead Primarina, Moonblast did 54 resisted to Gholdengo; 2 partners unknown from Dragonite/Gholdengo/Kingambit/Sneasler/Garganacl. Save Mega Garchomp for Steel/Rock/Fighting threats, Mimikyu Disguise for Dragonite/Sneasler cleanup. Gholdengo pressures Primarina now; beware stronger Water move, Recover as needed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Gholdengo vs Primarina damage, weighing Nasty Plot setup against Moonblast and possible Water move risks.Evaluating Make It Rain versus Nasty Plot based on predicted water move damage and switch risk.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Garchomp and Leftovers Gholdengo (at 78%). Moonblast did 28%, so it's somewhat bulky. With Liquid Voice, Hyper Voice is a 90 BP Water move and hits Gholdengo neutrally for ~50-55%, putting it neatly in Scarf Gholdengo's Shadow Ball KO range (or Primarina's next hit/Aqua Jet). Stay in with Primarina to survive Make It Rain/Shadow Ball/Nasty Plot and fire off Hyper Voice.

Primarina has Liquid Voice: Water Hyper Voice did 102 to Gholdengo, Moonblast 54 resisted. Gholdengo outspeeds and at -2 SpA cannot KO at 69%. Recover loops positively with Leftovers and may force a switch. Save Mega Garchomp for Steel/Rock/Fighting threats, Mimikyu Disguise for Dragonite/Sneasler.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and switch options to avoid a stalling loop against Primarina.Assessing a switch to Mimikyu and the trade of sacrificing Gholdengo to enable a Garchomp KO.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Garchomp (100%) and Leftovers Gholdengo (31%, -2 SpA). Primarina is at 130/187 HP and easily survives any attack from -2 Gholdengo (~51 dmg from Make It Rain). Liquid Voice Hyper Voice did 53% last turn, so it KOs Gholdengo or heavily chunks a switch-in. Keep Dragonite's Multiscale and Scarf Gholdengo healthy in the back.

Primarina has Liquid Voice: Water Hyper Voice does ~97 to Gholdengo, Moonblast 54 resisted. Gholdengo outspeeds, at -2 SpA cannot KO 69% Primarina and dies if it attacks. Recover+ Leftovers gains ~12 HP per loop, stall to higher HP or force switch. Save Mega Garchomp and Mimikyu Disguise for unseen partners.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage calculations and move choices to determine if Gholdengo can survive and KO Primarina.Evaluating Recover stalling versus switching options against Primarina's damage output and PP limits.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Garchomp (100%) and Leftovers Gholdengo (38%, -2 SpA) with Make It Rain and Recover. Liquid Voice Hyper Voice does ~50-53% to Gholdengo, out-damaging Recover+Leftovers. Stay in and spam Hyper Voice to keep pressuring Gholdengo (or chip a switch-in) while keeping Dragonite's Multiscale and Scarf Gholdengo at 100% HP.

Primarina Liquid Voice Hyper Voice does ~100 to Gholdengo; at -2 SpA Gholdengo cannot KO and Recover only stalls with 6 PP left. Switch Mimikyu: Disguise absorbs hit, Swords Dance, then +2 Play Rough should KO 69% Primarina. Preserve Gholdengo to Recover later; save Mega Garchomp for Steel/Rock/Fighting partners.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage calculations and turn order to compare attacking versus using Recover against Gholdengo.Evaluating PP exhaustion and switch options after ruling out a stable stall.Switching to Mimikyu to use Disguise for a free Swords Dance and break Primarina.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Garchomp (100%) and Leftovers Gholdengo (39%, -2 SpA) with Make It Rain and Recover. Liquid Voice Hyper Voice does ~50-55% to Gholdengo, forcing it to burn Recover PP (6/8 left) or faint. Stay in with Primarina and spam Hyper Voice to keep Gholdengo pinned (or chip a switch-in) while keeping Dragonite and Scarf Gholdengo at 100%.

Primarina Liquid Voice Hyper Voice does ~85-96 to Mimikyu, so 116 HP survives one hit after Disguise break. Swords Dance now, then +2 Life Orb Play Rough should KO 69% Primarina next turn before it attacks again. Preserve weakened Gholdengo; save Mega Garchomp for Steel/Rock/Fighting partners.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage to determine if Mimikyu survives Primarina's Hyper Voice after disguise breaks to enable a safe Swords Dance setup.Evaluating switch-in risk and neutral damage to compare immediate Play Rough versus Swords Dance setup.

decisions.thought: Opponent's 3: Mimikyu (87%, Disguise broken), Garchomp (100%), Leftovers Gholdengo (39%, Make It Rain/Recover). Mimikyu outspeeds Primarina (130/187 HP), survives one hit, and likely uses Swords Dance or Play Rough. Stay in and use Liquid Voice Hyper Voice to put Mimikyu into Aqua Jet/Scarf Gholdengo KO range, preserving Dragonite's Multiscale and Scarf Gholdengo at 100%.

Primarina: Liquid Voice Hyper Voice ~100 to Gholdengo, ~85 to Mimikyu, Sitrus Berry. Mimikyu is +2 Atk at 32 HP; Play Rough should KO 69% Primarina before it moves. Gholdengo at 77 HP can Recover later. Save Mega Garchomp for unseen Steel/Rock/Fighting partners.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating Pokémon damage using the level 50 formula to confirm a guaranteed KO with Play Rough.

decisions.thought: Opponent's 3: Mimikyu (24% HP, +2 Atk, Disguise broken), Garchomp (100%), Leftovers Gholdengo (39%, Make It Rain/Recover). Mimikyu outspeeds Primarina and will likely click Play Rough to KO. Use Aqua Jet for priority chip (and potential KO with Life Orb recoil) before Primarina goes down, preserving Dragonite's Multiscale and Scarf Gholdengo at 100%.

Both leads fainted. Send healthy Garchomp: threatens Kingambit, Garganacl, Sneasler, and opposing Gholdengo with Earthquake, Dragonite with Stone Edge/Scale Shot. Preserve 77 HP Gholdengo to Recover later and check Dragonite/Kingambit. Primarina had Liquid Voice Hyper Voice, Moonblast, Aqua Jet, Sitrus.

Opponent has Garchomp (100% HP) and Leftovers Gholdengo (39% HP, Make It Rain/Recover). Double KO gives a free switch. Send in Dragonite (100% HP, Multiscale intact, Lum Berry): vs Gholdengo, Dragonite easily tanks a hit and threatens Earthquake or Dragon Dance; vs Garchomp, Multiscale guarantees surviving any hit to OHKO with Ice Spinner. Save Scarf Gholdengo in back to clean.

Primarina and Mimikyu dead; Gholdengo 77HP, Recover 6PP left. Dragonite fresh, likely Multiscale. Mega Scale Shot breaks Multiscale with multi-hits, boosts Speed for final foe (Kingambit/Garganacl/Sneasler/Gholdengo). Mega Speed still outspeeds Dragonite.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Garchomp vs Dragonite speed and Scale Shot damage versus Multiscale, weighing mega evolution tradeoffs.Evaluating mega evolution timing and Scale Shot damage against Multiscale while factoring speed changes.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Garchomp (100% HP) and Leftovers Gholdengo (39% HP, Make It Rain/Recover). Dragonite (100% HP, Multiscale intact) easily survives any attack from Garchomp and OHKOs with 4x effective Ice Spinner (or breaks Focus Sash so Extreme Speed finishes next turn). If Gholdengo switches in, it takes chip and we follow up with Earthquake or Scarf Gholdengo Shadow Ball.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Primarina and Mimikyu dead, Garchomp dead. Gholdengo 77HP vs Dragonite 42% with Ice Spinner. Make It Rain is strongest and should KO; -2 SpA can be offset later with Nasty Plot. Last foe unknown: Kingambit/Gholdengo/Sneasler/Garganacl. Save Recover PP (6 left) for after this KO if possible.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and damage calculations to choose Gholdengo's move against Dragonite.Selecting Make It Rain for guaranteed KO while weighing later type matchups.

decisions.thought: Opponent's last Pokemon is Leftovers Gholdengo at 39% HP. Use Earthquake with Dragonite to either KO it outright or heavily damage it if it Recovers. If Gholdengo outspeeds and KOs Dragonite, our Choice Scarf Gholdengo outspeeds and cleans up with Shadow Ball.
